samples.question: A reference dark shape is shown near the top, and three dark candidate shapes are shown below (left, centre, right). For each shape count (a) how many separate dark pieces it is made of, and (b) how many sealed white holes are walled off inside it. A candidate matches the reference exactly when both of those counts are the same. Which candidate matches the reference's counts? Answer with exactly one of left, centre, or right.
